description: Cleveland Fed Inflation Nowcasting chart data: https://www.clevelandfed.org/-/media/files/webcharts/inflationnowcasting/nowcast_month.json (also nowcast_year.json, nowcast_quarter.json)

Nowcasts of CPI, core CPI, PCE (headline) and core PCE price index; units percent change m/m (month file), y/y (year file); no seasonal-adjustment label in file (Cleveland Fed methodology: SA m/m, annualized not applied in month file)
Month being nowcast (chart subcaption). Rows Jan 2024 .. Oct 2026
File gives MM/DD without a year; year inferred from target month and date order (script C_cleveland_nowcast_history.py). Business days only
Inferred as the date on which Cleveland's 'Actual ...' series has a value (nowcast series is blank from that day). Cross-checked against ALFRED first-release vintages in notes_C.md
Last non-blank nowcast dated strictly before pce_release_date
First nowcast date strictly after cpi_release_date. Also given: on cpi day and day before. CPI-day PCE nowcasts appear to already incorporate that day's CPI
err = nowcast minus Cleveland's 'actual' (their first-print m/m, from unrounded BEA/BLS indexes); percentage points
